scenarios.name: Reopen a selection of drawings already in the session

scenario_steps.name: writable copies of `fixtures/cad/document-opening/OpenDrawingA.odd`, `OpenDrawingB.odd` and `OpenPart.opd` are staged in the same working folder
the user opens each drawing, inserts a base view referencing the staged OpenPart.opd, saves it and closes it
the user opens both staged drawings in separate tabs
two saved drawings are already open in separate tabs in the MCAD Software
one of those drawings is active
the Open dialog displays their exact saved files
`OpenDrawingA.odd` and `OpenDrawingB.odd` are open from their package paths
the user selects both drawings and chooses Open
both existing drawing tabs remain available
one of those drawing tabs becomes active
no duplicate tab is created for either drawing
